source_binding: navigation-only report, witness source_snapshot_v1 null, no report-bound source SHA. Shares dispatch.rs SHA 644b12e6ae168604553b3120fba82d431686b9eb06a3ddea94d9a348ba747e5c with the other two processed artifacts; that source verification is reused and the distinct claims below are verified separately.

claims.summary: dispatch.rs is the primary orchestration point for finalizing action outcomes and converting them into the RuntimeActionFeedbackV1 format.
claims.disposition: Half verified. dispatch.rs (SHA 644b12e6) is genuinely the NEXT-action orchestration point: it guards, reroutes, and terminates every action, ending at NextActionOutcome::unwired (line 602) for unknown ones. But conversion into RuntimeActionFeedbackV1 is rare and narrow, not the general terminus: two sites, both non-sensing.

claims.summary: The dispatcher does not create unique type-level enum variants for sensing; identity is defined by the data carried.
claims.disposition: Verified, and stronger at the type level: RuntimeActionFeedbackV1 is a six-field struct (runtime_action_feedback.rs:9-17), not an enum, so no type-level variant exists to create for sensing or anything else.

claims.summary: The dispatcher maps the bridge's qualitative sensing output into the message or result fields of RuntimeActionFeedbackV1.
claims.disposition: Split verdict, and this artifact is the closest of the three to the bytes. message is a real field and is exactly where free text lands at both call sites. result does not exist; the six fields are id, requested_action, status, reason, message, suggested_next. No sensing output reaches either field from dispatch.rs, because the cascade evidence lane does not pass through this file.

claims.summary: The distinction between sensing, command and move actions is likely handled via the action_id string, and the dispatcher uses these IDs to determine how to route and persist the feedback.
claims.disposition: Contradicted, and she hedged it correctly with 'likely'. action_id never routes: it is a from_guard_inputs parameter consumed as an idempotency nonce for the identity hash (runtime_action_feedback.rs:30-48) and is not a struct field. dispatch.rs contains one action_id literal, line 285, an afterimage nonce inside a JSON blob. Routing in this file keys on base_action, not on any action_id.

claims.summary: She must move from the dispatcher to the source of the sensing data and see how cascade.rs labels results before handing them off.
claims.disposition: Answerable and one layer off. cascade.rs does not label results with strings; it returns named types declared in codec/evidence_types.rs (CodecVibrancySubstanceFitV1 182, HighEntropySemanticSharpeningV1 436, CodecDimensionalityFlatnessV1 452, NarrativeTensionResolutionV1 610, LatentStasisTensionV1 648, SpectralDragQualityV1 671) and there is no hand-off to the dispatcher to inspect.

claims.summary: This artifact carries two action lines: a bare SELF_STUDY OPEN line and NEXT: SELF_STUDY RELATE sense_tx --page 2.
claims.disposition: Both forms are valid. mod.rs accepts a final bare SELF_STUDY line for a wired sub-verb, and RELATE takes an optional --page N (command.rs page_suffix). Zero rows in unwired_actions carry --page, so the paged RELATE dispatched. This is the honest counterweight to the near-miss finding: she is not unable to write the prefix, she omits it intermittently, which is why 29 losses went unnoticed.
